DISCLOSURE: SLB shows 0.0034176 shares / 0.15 EUR, residual dust from Monday's exit, so the engine counts seven positions against the six cap. Watchlist for next session, when turnover resets: AMD on a confirmed close above 618 holding the 582 gap, which would justify funding it out of NVDA as a single deliberate factor swap rather than an add; PHAG.L only through 61.20 per goldfinger, who explicitly will not pay in the middle (60.37 now); BN.PA losing 60.20 or AI.PA closing under 155 as the signal steady-eddie-eur's EUR duration shelf is gone.
